test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_lz4_exact_block (s String, u UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS default_compression_codec = 'LZ4'
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_lz4_exact_block SELECT repeat('p', 90) || toString(number), number FROM numbers_mt(40000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE t_lz4_exact_block FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
SELECT throwIf(count() != 1, 'lz4_read_big_exact_block: expected 1 active part') FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table = 't_lz4_exact_block' AND active
test.query: SELECT count() FROM t_lz4_exact_block WHERE s < 'q' SETTINGS max_block_size = 8192, preferred_block_size_bytes = 0
SELECT sum(u) FROM t_lz4_exact_block SETTINGS max_block_size = 8192, preferred_block_size_bytes = 0, optimize_use_implicit_projections = 0
